tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and recalled source note specify a four-parameter barrier-activated flux with sink-gradient inhibition. Five observations vary both u_now and s_grad over substantial ranges, providing enough information to numerically fit those parameters without purchasing another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The recalled mechanism recommends it only when the s_grad span is below 0.08; the existing rows span 0.25 to 2.25, so inhibition is already varied.
It omits the barrier activation and sink-gradient effects indicated by the signatures and recalled mechanism.
Its high-input turnover is not supported by the barrier/sink signatures; the recalled four-parameter mechanism is directly testable with the existing five varied rows.
No trajectory or horizon ambiguity is indicated; all observations target H=0.7 and the candidate is an algebraic law.
